decode_layout: input[0..] verbatim = txs_bytes: a postcard-encoded Vec<Vec<u8>> (varint element count n, then n repetitions of varint byte-length L_i followed by L_i raw bytes, each inner Vec<u8> being one EIP-2718 RLP-encoded Ethereum transaction). No header, no framing added. Smallest well-formed input is the single byte 0x00 (zero transactions); short/empty/malformed input makes postcard::from_bytes return Err, which the original body already handles by returning a zeroed VerificationResult, so DECODE is total and cannot panic. Output: u32 LE tx_count | u32 LE recovered_count | u32 LE signer_count | signer_count * 20 raw address bytes.
